sectors.trend: Big four banks advance as oil and bond yields ease, supporting net interest margin expectations. However, Bathla insolvency storm and private credit concerns (headline 60) raise credit-loss overhang. IMF fiscal warning pressures sovereign credit backdrop.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX likely to outperform short-term on easing yields, but watch NPL trends from Bathla contagion. State interest cost surge (headline 51) pressures government-linked lending.

sectors.trend: Strong exploration pipeline in WA: Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE, Critica rare earths carbonate, Augustus gold (30g/t target), Auric Burbanks hardware acquisition. Record gold grades at Aguia (Colombia). AUD weakness supports commodity revenue in AUD terms.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from AUD softness. Junior explorers (Critica, Augustus, Auric) see catalyst-driven upside. Rare earths theme gains policy tailwind. Coal policy uncertainty (headline 50) a wildcard for energy miners.

sectors.trend: Fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports threatens distribution margins. Middle East oil shock risk (headline 48) adds volatility. Coal policy direction under Albo government creates regulatory uncertainty.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDS.AX face margin pressure from supply constraints. Oil price easing supports downstream but supply logistics remain a risk. Coal transition policy (headline 50) creates binary risk for thermal coal assets.

sectors.trend: Coles holds milk prices despite axing farmer support (headline 22). Backpacker visa cuts hit farming and tourism supply chains. Real wages growth crushed by exploited workers (headline 58). Cue and Veronika Maine fashion brands face collapse.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CBA.AX (consumer lending) face margin pressure. Tourism names (Qantas, APY) hit by backpacker cuts. Consumer discretionary under pressure; staples defensive bid likely.

sectors.trend: ACCC moves to break real estate monopoly. Tenants see rent relief. Trump policy mulls crashing Aussie house prices. Housing affordability remains a political flashpoint.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) may benefit from rent relief and regulatory pressure on landlords. Residential property developers face policy risk. Monitor ACCC enforcement timeline.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn datacentre in western QLD signals major AI infrastructure investment. AI regulation (smart glasses ban, new AI rules) creates compliance costs. News Corp adopts AI for news generation. Tokenised stock trading cleared by SEC.
sectors.implications: Australian datacentre and infrastructure names benefit. CSL.AX, CAR.AX in healthcare tech see AI drug discovery tailwinds. Regulatory risk for AI hardware. Long-term structural theme.

sectors.trend: Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk weight-loss drugs effective at smaller doses (positive for adoption). Novartis/Ionis cholesterol trial fails. Global pharma R&D pipeline mixed.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SSW.AX, XRO.AX benefit from global biotech momentum. Weight-loss drug demand supports long-term healthcare spend. Cholesterol trial failure a minor negative for lipid therapeutics.

key_themes: AUD weakness post-Fed 'Warshach test' failure supports commodity exporters but pressures importers and rate-sensitive sectors
IMF fiscal warning + RBA rate hike looming creates headwind for rate-sensitive REITs and property
WA mining exploration super-cycle: copper, rare earths, gold, PGE targets attracting capital
Consumer squeeze: real wages crushed, Coles pricing power, backpacker supply shock
AI infrastructure buildout in Australia (Anthropic QLD datacentre) as structural growth theme
Insolvency contagion risk from Bathla collapse into private credit and SME lending
Housing policy pivot: ACCC anti-monopoly, rent relief, Trump external pressure on house prices
Fuel supply logistics risk at east-coast ports

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD depreciation and RBA rate hike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour commodity exporters (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) over import-heavy consumer names. Monitor RBA statement for forward guidance.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bathla insolvency contagion into private credit
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to private credit-linked instruments; favour listed bank debt over unlisted credit. Monitor NPL disclosures from big four.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor WES.AX, WDS.AX margins; consider energy transition names as structural hedge.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer demand erosion from real wage compression
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) over discretionary. Watch retail sales data for inflection.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing policy shock (ACCC, Trump external pressure)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from residential REITs; favour industrial and healthcare REITs. Monitor ACCC enforcement actions.
Maintain energy hedges; monitor Brent crude and LNG contract prices. BHP.AX, WES.AX as indirect beneficiaries.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA exploration and rare earths names
opportunities.rationale: Dalaroo, Critica (58% carbonate), Augustus (30g/t gold), Auric Burbanks create a concentrated WA mining catalyst cluster. AUD weakness amplifies AUD-denominated commodity revenue.

opportunities.recommendation: Add big four bank exposure on yield easing
opportunities.rationale: Banks advance as oil and bond yields ease. NIM expansion likely if RBA pauses. Credit risk from Bathla is contained if contagion stays isolated.
Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre signals multi-year capex cycle. Australian infrastructure and power names benefit structurally.
Real wages crushed, Coles pricing power intact, backpacker supply shock. Staples defensive bid in rate-hike environment.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: ACCC anti-monopoly action, rent relief, and Trump house-price pressure create policy overhang. Rate hike looms.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with commodity-linked positions
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD crushed post-Fed. Commodity exporters gain; importers and rate-sensitive sectors lose.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid private credit and unlisted SME lending exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla insolvency storm signals broader credit stress. Private credit 'cockroaches' eating rich-listers suggests systemic fragility.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor fuel supply chain for margin compression
defensive_moves.rationale: East-coast port supply crunch threatens WES and WDS distribution margins. Middle East oil shock adds tail risk.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to hold gains on easing oil/bond yields and bank strength, but AUD weakness and IMF fiscal warning cap upside. RBA rate hike risk and Bathla contagion create volatility. Expect range-bound ^AXJO with sector rotation into banks and miners, out of REITs and discretionary.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural themes favour WA mining (copper, rare earths, gold), AI infrastructure (Anthropic QLD), and healthcare (weight-loss drug adoption). Fiscal tightening per IMF and state interest cost surge constrain public spending. Housing policy pivot and ACCC action reshape property sector. Superannuation reform debate may unlock capital reallocation. 6-12 month outlook moderately positive for ^AXJO if global growth holds.
